title: poker: server-side deal/burn/reveal phase execution
description: Phase.server_action is stored as a raw string or list of strings (e.g. 'deal(deck, hand, count:2, to:each_player)') but is never executed. Need an execute_server_phase(session, phase_name) function that parses and runs server_action verbs: deal(src, dst, count:N, to:each_player) pops N cards from src StackZone into each player's hand SetZone; burn(src, dst, count:N) pops N cards into discard SetZone; reveal(src, dst, count:N) pops N cards face-up into community SetZone. This unblocks the deal, flop, turn, river phases. Tests: TestTier2ServerDealGap and Tier3 skips in tests/test_poker.py.
